# Data preparation {#sec-data-prep}

:::{.aside}

Our setup for this R session is: 
```{r}
#| warnings: false
#| message: false
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(ecoSynthesis)
library(ggplot2)
here::i_am("elicitation/index.qmd")
output_dir <- here::here("output-XREFs")
source(here::here("inc/setup.R"))
source(here::here("inc/functions.R"))
load(here::here(output_dir, "lookup-tables.rda"))
```

:::

## Read membership table
Read data directly from a CSV file into a membership table:

```{r}
TASVEG_memb <- read_membership_tbl(
    here::here(output_dir, "First-round-output.csv"),
    source_id = "VEGCODE",
    target_id = "efg",
    membership = "memb",
    interpreter = "expert"
)

TASVEG_memb
```

### Check membership table

Let's check this file for errors:

```{r}
check_membership(TASVEG_memb, TASVEG, IUCN_GET)
```

### Clean membership table

We can clean these errors with this function:

```{r}
TASVEG_clean <- clean_membership(TASVEG_memb, TASVEG, IUCN_GET)
TASVEG_clean
```


:::{.aside}

We save both lookup tables in a file that we can load in later steps of the workflow:

```{r}
save(TASVEG_clean, file = here::here(output_dir, "memb-tables.rda"))
```

:::
